creator: Alexander Terp
description: Owner decided 2026-11-09: a pane brought back with Show Pane should return to where it was hidden from, as Reopen Pane already places a closed pane (exactly there if the tab is unchanged, else beside a pane it was beside, else at the tab's end), instead of always arriving in a tab of its own after the others. Today's behavior is by design (docs/cli/agents.md, "Out of sight": the old place may have been rearranged or closed); this changes that design and its doc paragraph. Helpers hidden with --hidden were never shown and keep their shared tab.
title: Show Pane puts a hidden pane back where it was
